title: ATTDEF AcDbXrecord duplicate-record clone-policy source/output slice
mode: Local bounded P4a implementation with generated source and output controls
scope: Model ATTDEF AcDbXrecord subclass presence separately from its group-280 value.
Retain only the documented duplicate-record clone policy values 0 and 1 for the locally selected source profile.
Emit the subclass and field on ATTDEF/ATTRIB DXF output when present, with version and representability refusal.
Keep all test inputs and generated outputs in per-test scratch storage; add no persistent DWG/DXF fixtures.

externalSources.title: Autodesk ATTDEF DXF reference
externalSources.supports: The ATTDEF DXF table documents an AcDbXrecord subclass marker followed by group 280 duplicate-record cloning policy; the same table also documents further fields that this slice deliberately does not model.

externalSources.title: LibreDWG current DWG/DXF grammar
externalSources.supports: Current source has the AcDbXrecord/keep_duplicate_records tokens active in the ATTRIB DXF grammar, while the corresponding ATTDEF DXF grammar has those tokens commented out. This divergence is recorded as a compatibility limitation, not independent confirmation of the ATTDEF profile.

evidence.sourceProfile: Runtime-authored minimal ATTDEF body using Autodesk-documented AcDbXrecord plus group 280. Profiles cover AC1021, AC1024, AC1027, AC1032, ASCII and Binary DXF, and clone values 0 and 1.
evidence.sourceCreation: Generated locally from scratch by tests/attdef_xrecord_controls.h at test runtime; no downloaded or pre-existing DWG/DXF fixture was added.

implementation.summary: ATTDEF/ATTRIB parsing now captures AcDbXrecord presence independently from keepDuplicateRecords, rejects invalid/incomplete profiles and unmodeled secondary fields, and preserves duplicate group-280 roles. DXF output emits group 100 AcDbXrecord followed by group 280 for retained presence/value, and refuses pre-AC1018 output, embedded-MTEXT composition, and out-of-domain clone values.
implementation.abiQualification: NOT_PERFORMED; DRW_Attrib gained a public data member. P8 ABI/consumer qualification remains open.

generatedControls.sourceSpanAssertions: Independent raw-span walker verifies exact marker/value source positions and field roles.
generatedControls.outputAssertion: Independent ASCII/Binary wire walker checks subclass order and exact integer value before fresh typed reimport.
generatedControls.invalidValue: Clone value 2 cannot produce a complete source profile; corrected value 1 succeeds through the same reader.
generatedControls.downgrade: AC1015 export is refused while preserving a destination sentinel; same writer retries successfully at AC1024 and emits the retained field.

results.initialNamingCleanupBuild: A temporary helper rename broke generic compound replay callers; the rename was reverted and the final strict build passed.

limitations: The profile is generated from the Autodesk reference and has no native-producer artifact; it proves local source-span/model/output/readback behavior only.
The ATTDEF fields after group 280, including secondary attribute reference counts and hard-pointer dependencies, remain unmodeled and fail closed.
ATTDEF Xrecord plus embedded MTEXT remains unsupported by this writer path.
LibreDWG's current ATTDEF grammar comments out this subclass/value pair, so it provides no independent ATTDEF compatibility proof.
No native semantic, ABI, LibreCAD, LibreCAD_3, FreeCAD, cross-platform or release claim is promoted.
